mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden inflation spike in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% triggers investor fear of overheating, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as capital flows into safer assets.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0, or the inflation spike is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and labor market strength (UNRATE falling) signals robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 and UNRATE move in opposite directions or their combined effect is weak.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly during FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle periods, or the regime is not late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and supply capacity (INDPRO) reduces inflationary pressures, fostering investor confidence and generating positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain non-positive when GDPC1 and INDPRO move inversely or their combined effect is negligible.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4.0 in the next week
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise significantly despite UNRATE crossing below 4.0, or the unemployment rate does not sustain the decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in INDPRO indicates expanding supply capacity, easing upward pressure on prices and encouraging long-term investment, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-positive during sustained INDPRO growth, or the supply expansion is not robust enough.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained fall in UNRATE below 5.0% signals labor market normalization, reducing risk premiums and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly during UNRATE declines in post-shock recovery periods, or the regime is not post-recession.
